answer: Proof-of-Stake acts as a vital relic for identity verification in agent economies. By requiring nodes to lock capital, the network enforces a cost-prohibitive barrier against Sybil attacks. An attacker faces a downward spiral of asset devaluation if they attempt to manipulate consensus through multiple false personas. Similar to the erratic path of a zephyr, validator influence is tethered to verifiable economic weight, ensuring that creating fake identities provides no advantage without massive, verifiable capital expenditure.
